requirements.evidence: Total generation grew by 17.9% between 2015 and 2025, reaching 82.1 TWh.
requirements.reason: The report provides a growth figure of 17.9%, but fact-check data indicates the actual generation growth in TWh was 27.8% (though 17.9 matches the absolute TWh increase scale incorrectly labeled as a percentage).
The report completely fails to mention any key risk for the coming years grounded in the data.
